topic: Template Class Inheritance with Template Parameters
explanation: In C++, class templates can inherit from other classes, including template classes, by specifying template parameters as base classes. When a template parameter is used as a base class, it must be a fully defined class at instantiation time, not just declared. This allows for flexible and generic inheritance hierarchies where the base class can be specified as a template parameter, enabling powerful compile-time polymorphism and code reuse. Understanding this concept is essential for designing generic, reusable class hierarchies in modern C++.
